lead.headline: Likely missed Friday, and nothing can cover him
lead.deck: He has no designation and Harbaugh says 'minor'. Tuten practised Friday, so the rule says start him. Taylor's quarterback is gone.
lead.body: Bad news first: Isaiah Likely did not practise Friday (groin). The Giants gave him no designation and Harbaugh called it 'minor', so he starts. But you carry no second tight end, Rice and Odunze lock at 12:00, and the only unlocked drops at 13:55 are Jacobs and Golden, so an inactive Likely means a zero at TE. Jonathan Taylor's 6.7 is final, and Indianapolis released Daniel Jones on Friday: Anthony Richardson starts from Week 12. The morning's Tuten rule resolved. He practised on a limited basis Friday and is off Jacksonville's final report, so start him and leave Rice on the bench. The lineup as set is the projection lineup. You lead KEI returns 6.7 to 6.5.
